'''This is a Beautiful World''' is the ending theme for the English [[dub]] of ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]''. It is sung by Aaron Brotherton. It is produced and directed by [[John Loeffler]] and [[David Wolfert]].

It is also used as one of the ending themes of ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]''.
